oneOf.description: Parses all supported syntaxes at once. Select a specific one when syntaxes conflict (ex. Lua 5.2 labels and Luau type assertions).

lineWidth.description: The width of a line the formatter will try to stay under. Note that this limit will be exceeded in some cases.

useTabs.description: Whether to indent with tabs instead of spaces.

indentWidth.description: The number of spaces for an indent. With tabs, this is the width of a tab when deciding where to wrap lines.

newLineKind.description: The kind of newline to use.

oneOf.description: For each file, uses the newline kind found at the end of the last line.
Uses the system standard (ex. crlf on Windows).

quoteStyle.description: The style of quotes to use in string literals.

oneOf.description: Uses double quotes, unless single quotes need fewer escapes.
Uses single quotes, unless double quotes need fewer escapes.

callParentheses.description: When to use parentheses around the arguments of a function call.

oneOf.description: Omits the parentheses when the only argument is a string.
Omits the parentheses when the only argument is a table.
Omits the parentheses when the only argument is a string or a table.
Keeps the parentheses as they are in the input.

collapseSimpleStatement.description: Which simple statements to collapse onto a single line.

oneOf.description: Keeps them collapsed or expanded as they are in the input.
Collapses simple functions and if guards.

blockNewlineGaps.description: Whether blocks keep the blank lines at their start and end.

oneOf.description: Keeps them when they are in the input.

spaceAfterFunctionNames.description: Where to put a space between a function name and its parameters or arguments.

sortRequires.description: Whether to sort consecutive require statements by their variable name.
